item.title: Potential Drinking Water Crisis Emerges Following Iranian Threats to Target Water Desalination Plants in the Gulf - Radio Free Syria
item.description: The UN warned of "global water bankruptcy" in January. India is sinking. America is drinking PFAS.

item.title: The Ghost System: Totalitarian Habituation in Syria’s Transitional Phase - Radio Free Syria
item.description: By Line Khatib The toppling of the Assad dictatorship marks the end of a physical era in Syria, but it has revealed a more resilient architecture of control: the Ghost System. In this critical transitional phase, Syria is grappling with Totalitarian Habituation; a condition where the psychological software of the dictatorship continues to run on […]

item.title: Last Ships to Arrive in 10 Days, Then Some Countries Will Be Plunged into Darkness This Summer - Radio Free Syria
item.description: Qatar's Energy Minister announced that due to the destruction at Ras Laffan, 17% of total production capacity (approximately 13 million tons/year) will be unusable for the next 3 to 5 years, and that a "force majeure" event may be declared.

item.title: UN Security Council Sends a Message of Stability for Syria - Radio Free Syria
item.description: Syria's Permanent Representative to the UN, Ibrahim Olabi, confirmed that Syria is moving towards a comprehensive national path that is gaining increasing support within the council.

item.title: Internal Consolidation and Geopolitical Risks in the First Year of the Syrian Revolution - Radio Free Syria
item.description: The new political model that will emerge in Syria has a strategic impact that could determine not only the country's internal political architecture but also regional power balances and the future geopolitical orientation of the Middle East.

item.title: Another Israeli Incursion in Rural Northern Quneitra - Radio Free Syria
item.description: Israeli occupation forces continue to escalate their attacks in Syria, as regionally, launching another invasion of rural northern Quneitra on Tuesday.

item.title: Iran War Escalates into Multi-Domain Conflict, New Intelligence Assessment Warns - Radio Free Syria
item.description: The Iran war is entering a new phase, with cyber operations, AI-driven influence campaigns, disinformation, disruption, and digital attacks increasingly integrated into military action, signalling a broader and more complex escalation.

item.title: Large Oil Trades Ahead of Trump’s Iran Statement Raise Insider Trading Concerns - Radio Free Syria
item.description: Large oil trades reportedly placed minutes before Trump announced “productive” talks with Iran have raised questions over possible advance knowledge after markets reacted sharply to the statement.

item.title: Border Disputes Between Lebanon and Syria Resurfaced Amid Developments in the Middle East - Radio Free Syria
item.description: Haytayan emphasized that "the Lebanese government should be one of the governments in contact with the new administration in Syria and should initiate discussions on issues concerning both countries, especially following the border clashes between Lebanese tribes and the Syrian army," adding, "The Lebanese state needs to seriously engage with the current Syrian authorities."

item.title: Volkswagen in Talks to Produce Israeli Missile Defence Systems in Return to Wartime Manufacturing Roots - Radio Free Syria
item.description: German carmaker Volkswagen is considering converting a factory to produce components for Israel’s Iron Dome system—marking a return to military production for a company that began with building military vehicles and weapons for the Nazi regime, with Berlin backing the controversial plan.
